call_points.text: Management expects historical revenue growth rates to be a good indication for next year's growth, with no specific FY27 revenue guidance provided.
Aims to increase license-driven revenue from current 3% of sales to 20% by 2030 to expand gross margins.
Utilised IPO proceeds in April 2026 to repay all long-term debt, rendering the company entirely debt-free.
Clients generating over USD 1 million in revenue increased to 59 in FY26 from 53 in FY25.
Output and outcome contracts carry 5-7 percentage points higher gross margin than input pricing, while license revenue yields 25-30 points higher margins.
FY26 revenue growth was 27% excluding TMT, which suffered from a client JV migration, client restructuring, and revenue recognition delays.
Qure.ai has built a strong order pipeline following calendar year setbacks from USAID funding cuts, lifting a profitability drag on Fractal.
Full year FY26 organic constant currency revenue growth stood at 13% YoY.
Cash and cash equivalents reached ₹2,052 Cr, supported by IPO proceeds of ₹956.8 Cr.

timeline.summary: Fractal Analytics Limited’s **Somya Agarwal** announces a conference call on May 12, 2026, from 8:00 AM IST to discuss audited Q4FY26 and FY26 results.
Fractal Analytics reported Q4FY26 consolidated PAT of ₹115.8 Cr and approved the merger of Senseforth Inc. into Fractal Analytics Inc.
Fractal Analytics reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹886 Cr (+17% YoY) and net income of ₹116 Cr (+109% YoY).
Fractal Analytics published its Q4 FY26 investor presentation highlighting a 109% YoY jump in quarterly net income to ₹115.8 Cr.
Fractal Analytics Limited hosted Q4 FY26 earnings call on May 12, 2026, with audio recording uploaded by **Somya Agarwal**, Director, at fractal.ai/investor-relations.
Fractal Analytics discussed Q4 & FY26 results on its earnings call, noting long-term debt repayment post-IPO and targeting 20% license revenue by 2030.
Fractal Analytics Limited’s **Somya Agarwal** scheduled in-person analyst/investor meets on May 25, June 1, and June 2, 2026, in Mumbai.
Fractal Analytics board approved ₹57.6 Cr ($6 mn) investment via CCCPS by Fractal US into step-down subsidiary Asper US by March 31, 2027.
Fractal Analytics shareholders passed 9 special resolutions via postal ballot ratifying ESOP schemes and approving AoA amendments for board nomination rights.
Somya Agarwal, CFO, will virtually attend Choice Institutional Equities’ InsightX Virtual Forum on June 11, 2026, under SEBI’s disclosure rules.

Fractal Analytics Limited hosted Q1 FY27 earnings call on July 24, 2026, with audio recording available at fractal.ai/investor-relations/earnings-call-q1-fy27/ as per SEBI regulations, signed by **Somya Agarwal**.
Fractal Analytics Limited will hold analyst/institutional investor meetings on November 11, 16, 17, 18, 19, 26, December 2, and 3, 2026, as scheduled.
